criteria.contract: New explicit v17 consensual direct-retainer road supply reserves actual free house rice at a physical home meeting, binds the same army/case/owner and fixed destination, and excludes other jobs without duplicating troops or grain

Carrier uses common land roads and known-only route planning; unknown closure is observed physically, destination waits for actual same-case army/commander assembly and capacity, and only one actual meeting transfers rice Deliver only actual free capacity in whole kilograms, retaining all remainder on the carrier; simultaneous convoys cannot reserve or fill the same capacity twice.

Physical cancellation receipt and expiry block later delivery without undoing earlier delivered grain; carrier completes its current road leg/journey safely and returns unused real grain to the original house Partial delivery followed by cancellation returns only unused cargo, preserving already consumed/delivered grain; completed carriers may be assigned again.

Stop/delivery/return observations are immutable dated sealed reports through the existing courier system; opening and known failure/retry/cancellation acknowledgement remain distinct from actual cargo or effect, with no remote current-state leak

Normal entry/UI, explicit limits, legacy v16 and earlier actual save-byte preservation, actual generation recovery/future equality and headless Godot placement are checked; GUI/full suite remain explicitly unverified Supply report notification uses the existing delivery/attention pause, separated from report opening and physical receipt.

limits: New v17 only. Local principal and consenting adult direct retainer agree100kg or less of actual free house rice to the same army/case at a fixed land-connected assembly node within30days. Partial whole-kg receipts, remainder custody and physical return. Not all-faction autonomous dispatch planning, moving-army interception, sea transport, escort/robbery, casualties, horse/ammunition logistics or unrestricted remote house orders. GUI/full3186 NOT_RUN.
